plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETF risk.
Sell MUU and METU to reduce exposure to leveraged semiconductor and AI plays.
Trim SPY to lower concentration in broad index holdings.
Add to QQQI to increase focus on income generation.
Trim CRWD to reduce concentration in a single AI/Software name.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation with reduced leverage.
conservative.read: This conservative approach aims for lower monthly gains (~1.5%) by significantly reducing leverage and focusing on income and broad index exposure. The risk of large drawdowns is minimized, but upside potential is also capped.

plan: Trim SOXL and SPAL to maintain minimal leveraged ETF exposure.
Slightly trim MUU and METU to reduce leverage in specific sectors.
Trim SPY to bring broad index exposure closer to the target.
Trim CRWD to reduce concentration in a single AI/Software name.
Buy GEV as a new, high-potential long setup.
This plan balances risk reduction with targeted growth opportunities.
balanced.read: This balanced strategy targets moderate monthly gains (~2.5%) by reducing leverage and concentration while adding a promising new name. It aims for risk-first growth, accepting a moderate level of drawdown risk.

plan: Trim SPY to reduce broad index concentration, freeing up capital.
Add to SOXL and SPAL to increase exposure to leveraged ETFs.
Add to MUU and METU to increase leverage in semiconductors and AI.
Buy GEV and TSM as new, high-scoring long setups.
This plan aggressively pursues growth through increased leverage and concentration.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets higher monthly gains (~4%) by increasing leverage and concentrating in high-scoring setups, including leveraged ETFs. Expect significantly higher potential drawdowns and the risk of rapid losses due to leverage and ETF decay.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) and leveraged sector plays (MUU, METU) to remove volatility.
Sell high-beta single names CRWD and SNOW to focus on stability.
Trim SPY to create more room for income-focused assets.
Add significantly to QQQI to maximize monthly income generation.
This plan prioritizes steady income and capital preservation over growth.
income.read: This income-focused strategy aims for lower monthly distributions (~1%) by prioritizing income-generating assets and minimizing volatility. While NAV can still fall, the focus is on reliable cash flow and low drawdowns, not aggressive growth.
